summary.text: Trey Paradee has represented Delaware Senate District 17 since 2018, after serving in the House of Representatives for the 29th District from 2012 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to his official page, Paradee was born and raised in Dover and holds a bachelor's degree (1991) and an MBA (1998) from the University of Delaware.
The page says he worked as a financial advisor and founded Paradee Financial LLC in 2011.
